summary: Implementation architecture remains layered as src/agent-runtime -> src/avatar-mediator -> src/blender-bridge -> tests. The current Sprite iteration is frozen as bridge-owned, visual-path-first work: explicit semantic acceptance baselines remain read-only and passed on first execution, while two new support guardrails intentionally fail until Coding/Repair binds assets/sprite.blend as the default observation scene and emits richer Sprite selection detail inside the existing BlenderFeedback.detail field.

explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Mediator outcome and structured Blender feedback expose a thinking-compatible state through the frozen explicit baseline.
Mediator outcome and structured Blender feedback expose a confirming-compatible state through the frozen explicit baseline.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: AvatarEmbodimentMediator.executeAction(action, requestId) against the configured disconnect path via tests/explicit/blender-disconnect-graceful-degradation.test.ts.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Mediator outcome surfaces degraded status and neutral-idle recovery through the frozen explicit baseline.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: architecture boundary guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: No direct import from src/blender-bridge appears in the runtime layer.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: dependency direction guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read src/blender-bridge/index.ts and src/avatar-mediator/index.ts import surfaces.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Bridge has no reverse import to runtime or mediator, and mediator imports the bridge contract only.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: explicit entrypoint correctness guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Resolve explicit testcase files and protected baseline fixture keys.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: All three explicit test entrypoints and their baseline metadata exist in the repository.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: traceability guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md and local ARCHITECTURE.md contracts.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Contracts mention the intended stable elements, explicit testcase entrypoints, intent element mappings, and bridge-owned Sprite observation binding.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: acceptance criteria script path guard
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read explicit testcase acceptanceCriteria values from design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Each explicit testcase points to an existing single executable script file accepted by the failure-record consumer.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: avatar mute override guard
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The mediator suppresses avatar execution while keeping the runtime control-loop callable.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: lifecycle mapping contract
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Deliver response_start and response_complete events through AgentRuntime against a recording bridge.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The runtime and mediator map lifecycle events to thinking and confirming semantic actions.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: structured feedback fixture shape
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Create the shared structured feedback fixture.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The fixture exposes acknowledgement, status, observedState, and detail fields.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: preemption policy guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Deliver two rapid lifecycle events to the mediator before the earlier avatar motion completes.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The newest semantic action wins and stale motion does not remain the visible outcome.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: sprite visual scene binding
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read scripts/blender-visual-adapter.mjs to inspect the default visual-scene binding contract.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The observation path defaults to assets/sprite.blend for this iteration while preserving explicit override via BLENDER_VISUAL_BLEND_FILE.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: sprite feedback detail contract
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read scripts/blender-visual-driver.py to inspect how Sprite observation detail is emitted.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The existing response shape is preserved, and the detail string names the selected Sprite preset, action family, or equivalent bridge-owned selection detail.

codingTargets.testcaseName: support guardrail: visual observation path defaults to the Sprite scene
codingTargets.failureSignal: scripts/blender-visual-adapter.mjs still falls back to --factory-startup instead of binding assets/sprite.blend as the default observation scene.
codingTargets.nextAction: Bind assets/sprite.blend as the default observation scene inside scripts/blender-visual-adapter.mjs while preserving BLENDER_VISUAL_BLEND_FILE as an explicit override.

codingTargets.testcaseName: support guardrail: visual driver detail names the Sprite-specific selection
codingTargets.failureSignal: scripts/blender-visual-driver.py still reports only generic visual rendering detail and does not name the selected Sprite preset or action family.
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement Sprite-specific preset selection and emit that selection through the existing detail field in scripts/blender-visual-driver.py.

openGaps: scripts/blender-visual-adapter.mjs does not yet default the observation path to assets/sprite.blend.
scripts/blender-visual-driver.py does not yet emit selected Sprite preset or action-family detail in BlenderFeedback.detail.
tests/support/preemption-policy.test.ts remains a todo support guardrail rather than an implemented executable check.
package.json does not define npm run validate:handoff:implementation, so formal implementation-handoff validation is currently blocked by repository tooling.
